Description: ElastiCache Replication Groups do not have Multiple Availability Zones (Multi-AZ) enabled.
Risk: Without Multi-AZ (failover) to enhance fault tolerance an outage or failure that affects a node of a whole Availability Zone will reduce availability, and potentially result in writes loss.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling Multi-AZ with automatic failover on replication groups, making use of replicas in different Availability Zones.
